text.tspan: Share of electricity generation from fossil fuels, renewables and nuclear

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Measured as a percentage of total electricity produced in the country or region. Fossil fuels include coal, oil, and gas.
Renewables include solar, wind, hydropower, bioenergy, geothermal, wave, and tidal.
